[research] research.premium-motion-params — Premium motion-graphics parameters (AE/Material/Apple) (status: todo, access: 0)
    RESEARCHED premium motion values (Apple HIG + Material Design + AE/Resolve, 2026):
EASING (linear is BANNED): Apple ease-out cubic-bezier(0,0,0.58,1); Material standard (0.4,0,0.2,1); Material emphasized-decelerate (0.05,0.7,0.1,1); easeOutBack overshoot (0.68,-0.55,0.265,1.55).
SPRINGS: overshoot 1-bounce = stiffness 150 / damping 12 / mass 1; snappy 210/20; gentle 120/14.
TIMING: entrance 225ms, exit 195ms, standard 300ms; stagger lists 30-60ms, grids 60-80ms; slow-in/fast-out.
CAMERA: continuous push-in 5-15% scale over the shot; never static; slow drift always on.
PARALLAX: 3-5 depth layers; speed ratios bg 0.3x -> fg 1.0x -> hero 1.5x; far layers smaller+blurrier (DoF).
RESTRAINT: 30-50% negative space; one idea per shot; type scale 1.333 (fourth) or 1.618 (golden).
FRAME RATE: 60fps modern-smooth UI; 24fps cinematic.
TRANSITIONS: cross-dissolve 18-24f, slide/push 18-24f, zoom-through 20-30f, whip 10-15f; transitions 0.3-0.5s; scenes overlap by the transition duration (TransitionSeries).
GRADIENTS: Stripe/Linear animate mesh via shifting color-stops + moving radial orbs + hue-rotate; full cycle 8-12s; 3-7 color stops; blur ~50-160px; continuous bg bridges cuts.
MATERIAL: Apple light bg #f5f5f7, text #1d1d1f, accent #0071e3; cinematic dark bg #0a0a0a; glass = blur 12-14px + saturate 180% + 1px edge; multi-layer soft shadow (Comeau); film grain via feTurbulence at soft-light ~6%.
IMPLEMENTED IN: engine/src/easing.ts, motion.ts, theme.ts, transitions.ts, scenes/premium/.
SOURCES: developer.apple.com/design HIG motion, m3.material.io/styles/motion, mantlr.com Stripe/Linear/Vercel, alexharri.com/blog/webgl-gradients, joshwcomeau.com/css/designing-shadows
[research] research.ae-resolve-param-catalog — AE/Resolve full parameter catalog for engine schema (status: todo, access: 0)
    AE + DaVinci Resolve parameter model the engine spec must expose for any-length video (1min-1hr):
COMPOSITION: width, height, fps (1-120), duration, color space, NESTED COMPS / pre-comps (sections->scenes->clips for long-form), preserve-fps/res.
LAYER TRANSFORM: anchor, position xyz, scale xyz, rotation xyz, opacity; parenting (child inherits parent), track mattes (alpha/luma), blend modes, 3D-layer toggle, motion-blur per layer, time-remapping, in/out points, layer markers.
KEYFRAMES: interpolation = linear | bezier | hold/stepped | auto-bezier | continuous; spatial vs temporal; easy-ease; velocity/influence graph (incoming/outgoing ease %); rove-across-time.
TIMELINE/TRACKS: stacking order, clip in/out + trim, ripple/roll, markers, RULE: one track holds NON-OVERLAPPING clips (HF enforces, Remotion ignores — this is the lint gap).
EFFECTS: adjustment layers (apply to all below), blur/glow/color/levels/curves/displace/distort, masks (path+feather+expansion), mattes.
TEXT: per-character/word/line animators, range selectors.
AUDIO: waveform-driven animation, level keyframes, beat/marker sync.
LONG-FORM: sections/chapters via nested comps, reusable motion presets/templates, proxies, render chunking.
NOT YET IN ENGINE (roadmap): per-property keyframe arrays, nested sections, time-remap, adjustment layers, text per-char animators.
SOURCES: helpx.adobe.com/after-effects composition-basics + responsive-design, m3.material.io/styles/motion
[research] research.lint-autofix-rules — Composition lint + auto-fix detection algorithms (status: todo, access: 0)
    RESEARCHED rule-based validation + autofix (the loop Remotion lacked; HF has lint/inspect/validate):
INTERVAL OVERLAP (same-track clips/tweens): (a.start<b.end) AND (b.start<a.end). Fix: nudge later, or move to new track, or shorten earlier.
AABB COLLISION (spatial): a.x<b.x+b.w && a.x+a.w>b.x && a.y<b.y+b.h && a.y+a.h>b.y. Overlap %% = IoU = inter/(areaA+areaB-inter). Fix: reflow to grid, or nudge apart along major-overlap axis.
OFF-SCREEN: box outside [0,0,fw,fh] +/- tol. Fix: clamp x=clamp(x,0,fw-w), or scale down.
TEXT OVERFLOW: measureText width vs container; fix scale font (binary search to 95%%), truncate+ellipsis, or expand container.
CONTRAST (WCAG): L=0.2126R+0.7152G+0.0722B; ratio=(Lhi+.05)/(Llo+.05); need 4.5:1 normal / 3:1 large. Fix: darken text, add shadow/backing box.
Z-ORDER: occlusion%% = inter/areaImportant > 0.5 -> raise z-index.
TIMING GAPS: frames with 0 visible elements > threshold -> shift later beats earlier; element never appears (start>=duration) -> clamp.
LAYOUT BY CONSTRUCTION: CSS-grid/flex auto-place (cols=ceil(sqrt(n)), cellW=(innerW-gap*(cols-1))/cols) so overlaps are impossible — prefer over hand-positioning.
PERF: O(n^2) at 60 elements = ~3600 pairs = <1ms in V8; never a bottleneck at video scale; Rust unnecessary.
IMPLEMENTED: engine/src/validate/{geometry,layout,lint}.ts; Player runs lintAndFix() pre-render; engine/lint-spec.mjs CLI.
KNOWN BUG: diagram col/row->px mapping in lint.ts mismatches Diagram.tsx, so node-collision detection currently misses — needs fixing.
SOURCES: MDN 2D collision, w3.org WCAG contrast, github heygen-com/hyperframes CLI, arxiv 2510.11498 ReLook vision-critic, MDN grid auto-placement
[research] research.video-storytelling-principles — Video storytelling + cinema + trailer + editing principles (status: todo, access: 0)
    RESEARCHED director-grade craft (encoded in skill video-director + agent video-director). STRUCTURES (map beats to %%): PAS (problem 0-30 / agitate 30-65 / solution 65-100, default SaaS), Before-After-Bridge (0-35/35-70/70-100), 3-Act (25-50-25), Pixar spine, compressed hero; peak tension 60-75%%, payoff 75-90%%, validate causality. HOOK: drop in 3-5s, pattern-interrupt in 0-2s, types ranked pattern-break>specific-promise>pain-callout>social-proof>curiosity-gap; >=2 shot changes in first 5s; no static block >5s; open a loop in hook. PACING ARC: setup/build/PEAK(fastest 50-75%%)/release(slow+hold)/CTA; long=depth short=energy; fast sequence MUST be followed by a hold. LOOPS: open 10-25%%, close 75-90%%, Zeigarnik; no orphaned loops. EMOTION: high-arousal (awe/surprise/aspiration) shares 2x; place primary in hook+peak+payoff. MESSAGE: one through-line, 'so what' test every shot. CUT-ON-BEAT: framesPerBeat=fps*60/BPM must be integer (60fps/120BPM=30); ASL 2-4s energetic, 4-6 cinematic, 0.5-2 climax; cut-on-action 40%% overlap; J-cut(audio leads 0.5-1.5s)=faster, L-cut(audio trails)=slower. SHOT GRAMMAR: vary size wide1.0/med1.3/close1.8/xclose3.0 via scale; close-up on emotional beat; no 2 identical consecutive. TRAILER: 3-act + stopdown (0.5-2s silence before logo) + sting (150-300ms on exact logo frame). CONTINUITY: 180deg analog = consistent screen direction LTR=forward; enter-where-you-exited. COLOR: cool/desaturated problem -> warm/saturated solution; single-accent for focus. CTA: earn it (deliver hook promise + close loop first), ONE only, action verb + specific outcome. SOURCES: masterclass.com 3-act + trailer + Kuleshov, studiobinder.com shot sizes, silvermansound.com BPM-FPS, savethecat.com beats, businessinitiative.org PAS, storyprompt.com BAB, nofilmschool.com trailer music, rareformaudio.com drop-vs-stopdown, fiveable.me 180-rule, pixflow.net color psychology, wistia.com video CTA, creatify.ai 2026 hooks.
[research] motion-design-12-principles — 12 motion-design principles -> enforceable schema rules (4 sources corroborated) (status: todo, access: 0)
    Sources: vmgstudios 10-principles, graduateschool 12-animation-principles, bottlerocketmedia guide, motionelements mastering guide. ENFORCEABLE (schema-checkable) rules distilled: (1) EASING: no all-linear hero track; entrances ease in/out (back/out). (2) ANTICIPATION: hero entrance has a counter-direction pre-move keyframe before the main move. (3) FOLLOW-THROUGH/OVERLAP: layers staggered (distinct start frames, not all 0). (4) SECONDARY/LAYERED: hero animates >=3 channels simultaneously. (5) STAGING/HIERARCHY: shot declares readOrder (eye-path). (6) ARCS: multi-kf position move not purely axis-aligned -> declare arc. (7) SQUASH/STRETCH: travel move declares scale dip. (8) TIMING/PACING: duration in the phase band; cut-on-beat frame integer (fps*60/bpm). (9) LAYERING/DEPTH: >=2 layers distinct depths. (10) CONTINUITY: in/out vectors chain. (11) MASS/WEIGHT: heavier element = longer decel. (12) APPEAL+EMOTION+THROUGHLINE per shot. These become REQUIRED xsd elements so a vague shot fails validation.
